name: std::time_get<CharT,InputIt>::~time_get
intro: Destructs a std::time_get facet. This destructor is protected and virtual (due to base class destructor being virtual). An object of type std::time_get, like most facets, can only be destroyed when the last std::locale object that implements this facet goes out of scope or if a user-defined class is derived from std::time_get and implements a public destructor.
